channel.title: DockFacts
channel.description: An independent research desk for Mac docks and multi-display setups. We compare published specs, date every claim, and never pretend we tested the hardware.

item.title: Best dock for a dual-monitor MacBook Air (M5)
item.description: The M5 MacBook Air can drive two 6K displays over one cable. These are the dock specs that make it work, four docks that fit, and the traps to avoid.

item.title: USB-C hub or Thunderbolt dock for a Mac? Use this 4-question test
item.description: A cheap USB-C hub and a premium Thunderbolt dock can both drive a monitor. The difference is display streams, bandwidth, and power. Four questions decide what you need.
